author_algorithm_semantics: X-HD ray-tracing route over uniform-grid tight cell MBRs.
Uses radius-growing iterations, OptiX custom primitives, early-break and prune flags, load-balance threshold lb, and heavy-cell offload queues.
Records Grid/BVH/MBRs/WL/WL Heavy Peak memory and iteration RTTime/CUDATime/OffloadingSize.

current_wrapper_surface.interpretation: The wrapper accepts author variant names and RTDL route controls, but it does not yet expose the author RT option surface for BVH build/update policy, early-break, prune, load-balance, n_points_cell, tune_grid, or tune_radius.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author -variant rt selects the X-HD RT implementation.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL accepts -variant rt and returns directed HDResult through a selected RTDL route.
feature_matrix.next_action: Keep value compatibility, but do not treat this as author RT-core algorithm identity.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author RT supports RT-specific controls such as radius, eb/prune, lb, n_points_cell, and tune_radius.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: The wrapper accepts author variant names and RTDL route controls, but it does not yet expose the author RT option surface for BVH build/update policy, early-break, prune, load-balance, n_points_cell, tune_grid, or tune_radius.
feature_matrix.next_action: Add an app-owned author RT option-surface gate: either implement semantics for each flag, map it to a generic RTDL control with evidence, or fail closed with an explicit unsupported status.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author RT organizes target points into a uniform grid and tight cell MBRs used as OptiX custom primitives.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: Generic grid/cell descriptors and native cell-MBR traversal exist and are used by the Level-B route, but exact author grid sizing and kernel/SBT identity are not claimed.
feature_matrix.next_action: Keep the generic cell-MBR substrate; compare author grid sizing and n_points_cell semantics before claiming RT-core equivalence.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author RT uses radius-growing iterations and tune_radius / n_points_cell decisions in the X-HD route.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL has grid-shape and seed controls, but no proven author-equivalent radius growth or tune-radius policy.
feature_matrix.next_action: Open a focused radius-growth semantics goal: extract author iteration inputs/counters and decide whether a generic radius schedule API is needed.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author EB/prune controls point-level culling and RT pruning behavior.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL has a generic global-bound early break that preserves exact directed-HD scalar values but may make per-source witnesses approximate.
feature_matrix.next_action: Separate exact-scalar and exact-witness contracts. Do not use the fast scalar route as witness parity evidence.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author RT uses lb-controlled load balancing and heavy-cell CUDA offload, with OffloadingSize / RTTime / CUDATime iteration fields.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL has generic heavy-offload row shape and telemetry, but the author queue byte denominator and Figure 7 matrix are not aligned.
feature_matrix.next_action: Target a denominator-aligned load-balance/offload gate before any Figure 7 or heavy-offload performance claim.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Author reports Grid, BVH, MBRs, WL, and WL Heavy Peak memory fields.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL status-bearing memory accounting exists for selected routes, but Goal5282 shows WL and WL Heavy Peak denominators are not fully aligned.
feature_matrix.next_action: Do not claim Figure 11 reproduction until byte denominators and field semantics are matched or explicitly accepted as different.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Figure 5 compares X-HD with EB, NN-KD, NN-Clover, ITK, and RT-HDIST baselines over paper workload families.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: RTDL accepts variant names as value requests only; non-rt algorithms and RT-HDIST external baseline are not reproduced.
feature_matrix.next_action: Decide which Figure 5 baselines are external comparisons and which, if any, RTDL intentionally implements as generic algorithms.

feature_matrix.author_semantics: Full paper reproduction requires exact paper input bytes or accepted exact-equivalence provenance.
feature_matrix.current_rtdl: Current best evidence is Level-B same-source representative; exact paper input identity remains blocked.
feature_matrix.next_action: Resume exact-input execution only if Goal5345 readiness changes and a command-ready real artifact packet exists.
